name: Fashion Valley
summary: Large shopping center with chain department stores, a movie theater & casual dining options.
description: Fashion Valley is a premier shopping destination in San Diego, managed by Simon Property Group, featuring an extensive collection of upscale retailers and luxury brands. The center offers a sophisticated open-air shopping experience in the heart of Mission Valley, combining high-end fashion, fine dining, and premium services.
demographics: Fashion Valley attracts an affluent demographic with above-average household incomes, drawing heavily from surrounding neighborhoods including Mission Hills, Point Loma, La Jolla, and Del Mar. The center's trade area serves middle to upper-income professionals, established families, and fashion-conscious millennials seeking premium brands and upscale dining experiences. Primary visitors are typically ages 25-54 with disposable income for luxury purchases, with strong representation from San Diego's coastal communities and international tourists visiting the area.
